subject: Acme MAP - Mutual Action Plan & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Acme MAP - Mutual Action Plan & next steps

Hi Ellen —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our call and the proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have alignment on goals, stakeholders, and timelines. Please review and flag any corrections. I attached a first-pass MAP and the pricing deck.

Key pain points you called out:
- Inference cost is the primary blocker today (spend unpredictability during spikes).
- 99th-percentile latency impacting product experience on heavy pages.
- Data isolation / PII requirements for certain customer flows (need VPC / Private deployment options).

Goals we agreed on:
- Reduce per-token inference costs ~35-45% vs current baseline.
- Achieve P99 latency <200ms for the primary product path.
- Pilot a private deployment for PII workloads with KMS integration.

Stakeholders (as discussed):
- Ellen Park - VP Product (decision lead)
- Samir Desai - Head of Platform (technical eval/architecture)
- Priya Rao - Legal (contract & security)
- Mark Chen - Procurement (purchase order & procurement timeline)

Proposed MAP (high-level milestones):
1) Architecture review (Redwood SE + Acme Platform) - owner: Samir - target: week of 2027-05-17
2) Security & compliance packet (SOC2 / encryption / KMS details) - owner: Priya - target: 2027-05-21
3) Pilot SOW & pricing agreement - owner: Mark (procurement) / Marissa (Redwood) - target: 2027-06-07
4) Pilot kickoff (data handoff + integration) - owner: Samir / Monica (Redwood CS) - target: 2027-08-15
5) Decision / roll (expand to prod or renew) - owner: Ellen - target: 2027-09-30

Open questions / asks from Acme:
- Pilot dataset size & expected QPS for sizing (Samir to confirm)
- Procurement/PO timeline (Mark) - whether June sign is acceptable
- SSO/SCIM integration timeline (if required)

Next steps (from our side):
- I'll schedule the architecture review with Dev for the week of May 17 - proposed slots: Tue 5/18 11am PT or Wed 5/19 9am PT.
- Attachments: Redwood-Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx, Redwood-Pricing-Deck.pdf (see links below).
- I'll send SOC2 and encryption docs to Priya by 5/21.

Please let me know if you want any changes to owners or dates. Happy to jump on a quick 15-min call to refine.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood-Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx]
[Attachment: Redwood-Pricing-Deck.pdf]

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acmecorp.com>

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme MAP - Mutual Action Plan & next steps

Thanks Marissa - this looks good and mostly aligned. A couple of notes:
- We do need SSO/SCIM as part of the pilot (Samir, please confirm the exact provider).
- Procurement is on a slightly accelerated path on our side - Mark is aiming to complete PO by 2027-05-28 if pricing and SOW are in place.
- For the pilot dataset, we're planning ~750k requests/day with peak bursts ~1.2k RPS; Samir will confirm exact QPS for the primary path.

Also please add Mark Chen as owner for the PO / contract milestone and loop legal (Priya) for the compliance packet. If you can get SOC2 + KMS notes to Priya by Friday 5/21 that would be great.

I've attached Mark's procurement contact card and our internal legal checklist.

- Ellen
Ellen Park
VP Product, Acme Corp
